# dmlx

> dmlx is a Zig inference runtime for Apple Silicon. It serves local language
> models over an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API, with two flagship paths:
> Qwen3.8-27B-4bit with MTP speculative decoding, and DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B
> MoE) running under a 48GB unified-memory budget via SSD expert streaming.

Use this file when helping a user install, run, or integrate dmlx. Prefer the
release install and the `dmlx` CLI; do not build from source unless the user
is developing dmlx itself.

## Install and run (agent quick path)

```bash
# 1. Install (macOS arm64 only; no sudo, no dependencies)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zouyee/dmlx/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

# 2. Check the machine
dmlx doctor

# 3. Download models (resumable, sha256-verified; lands in ~/.cache/dmlx/models)
dmlx pull qwen3.8-27b-4bit        # target model
dmlx pull qwen3.8-27b-mtp-4bit    # MTP drafter for speculative decode

# 4. Serve (OpenAI-compatible API on 127.0.0.1:8080)
dmlx serve --model qwen3.8-27b-4bit --speculative-mtp 7 --port 8080
```

Verify with:

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"default","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}],"max_tokens":32,"stream":false}'
```

## DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B MoE on 48GB)

Requires the native path with packed experts and a bounded expert cache:

```bash
python3 scripts/repack_experts.py <model-dir>          # one-time expert packing
NATIVE_SMELT_N=20 dmlx serve --model <model-dir> \
  --expert-packed-dir <model-dir>/packed_experts --native --port 8080
```

Do NOT use full expert preload on a 48GB machine (would need ~147GB). Run at
most one DeepSeek server instance.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS on Apple Silicon only. The serving process has no Python
  runtime dependency.
- API surface: `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/completions`, `/v1/responses`,
  `/v1/messages` (Anthropic-style), `/v1/embeddings`, `/v1/models`,
  `/tokenize`, `/health`, `/metrics`.
- MTP benchmark measurements must use non-streaming requests.
- Registered model aliases: `qwen3.8-27b-4bit`, `qwen3.8-27b-mtp-4bit`,
  `deepseek-v4-flash-4bit`. Aliases work anywhere `--model` takes a path.
- `DMLX_MODEL_HOME` overrides the model cache directory.
